title: Invoice extraction
description: What the extractor returns for one invoice: seven fields, each with the text as printed, the page, a bounding quote and a confidence. A field that cannot be read keeps value null. Nothing is normalized here; the rules code parses terms and amounts. The optional flags list carries text in the document that tries to instruct the reader or asks for money or credential changes.

flags.description: Suspicious text found in the document, quoted and never followed. Leave out when there is none.

value.description: The text exactly as printed, for example 'Net 45, 1/10'. Null when unreadable.

page.description: Page number where the value was found. Null when not found.

quote.description: The shortest exact snippet that contains the value. Null when not found.

confidence.description: 0 to 1. Zero for an empty field. Fields below the minimum in policy/term-rules.yaml are treated as unreadable.

quote.description: The exact text. No full bank or card number: at most the last four digits.
